As a Machine Learning Certification Researcher, you will address one of the most fundamental challenges in modern AI: proving that ML models are safe, reliable, and mathematically sound for deployment in autonomous flight. Your work will bridge the gap between cutting-edge statistical learning theory and formal aviation certification frameworks, building upon previous work (EASA CoDANN I and II, and FAA report DOT/FAA/TC-21/48), and putting real-world systems to the test.  At Destinus, we are shaping the future of defense through high-speed, autonomous flight technologies. We develop next-generation unmanned aerial systems that deliver greater speed, precision, and efficiency, supporting governments and defense organizations in mission-critical operations worldwide. Daedalean AG, the AI and autonomy hub of the Destinus Group, plays a key role in this vision—developing safety-critical AI systems at the intersection of advanced research and real-world aviation. Enabling machines to perceive, understand, and make decisions in real time, we combine aerospace engineering and artificial intelligence to build the next generation of autonomous flight systems, driving innovation where it matters most.   What You'll Do   • AI Certification Strategy: Analyze our existing AI certification strategy and help adapt it—or pioneer entirely new strategies—to certify different supervised ML.  • EASA Framework Alignment: Connect mathematical guarantees, technical arguments, and model evaluations to the EASA W-shaped process for AI certification in aviation, ensuring our research aligns with the latest regulatory guidelines.  • Theoretical Foundation & Modeling: Conduct research into statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and mathematical guarantees for deep neural networks operating under dynamic real-world conditions.  • Uncertainty Quantification: Apply statistics and stochastic processes to model environmental uncertainties and sensor noise, and to quantify confidence in performance metrics.  • Literature & Proof Evaluation: Critically evaluate academic literature, mathematical proofs, and engineering assumptions with peer-review rigor to identify safety limitations and theoretical gaps in state-of-the-art AI.  • Regulatory & Audit Justification: Construct robust, logical arguments and technical justifications that translate complex, high-dimensional empirical data into structured evidence for safety audits and certification frameworks.  • Algorithmic Validation: Write clean, reproducible code in Python to test theoretical hypotheses, validate certification mechanisms, and benchmark model safety frameworks.   Requirements    What You'll Need    Machine Learning Theory & Mathematics   • ML Theory & Statistical Learning: Deep understanding of statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and the math

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for a threat intel manager to build and run our Model Exploitation & Fraud team within Threat Intelligence. This team detects, investigates, and disrupts the large-scale exploitation of Anthropic's AI systems. Model distillation,  unauthorized access, account farming and reseller abuse, and fraud and scam operations.

You will set the strategy for the mission area, hire and lead a small team of technical investigators, and build the systems, processes, and partnerships that let the team scale. The team includes established senior investigators who own our deepest technical casework,  tracing distillation networks, reseller and proxy ecosystems, and financially motivated actors across first-party surfaces and third-party platforms; your job is to direct, resource, and amplify that work, not duplicate it. This area carries regular U.S. government engagement and requires deeply understanding external black market ecosystems and how they interact with our systems.

Important context: In this position you may be exposed to explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature. This role may require responding to escalations during weekends and holidays.

Key responsibilities

  • Own strategy, priorities, and outcomes for the Model Exploitation & Fraud mission area; define what we detect, investigate, action, and share
  • Hire, manage, and develop a team of technical threat investigators; set the quality bar for casework and intelligence reporting
  • Design clear lanes between this role and the team's senior individual contributors: strategy, people leadership, and program ownership sit with you, while ownership of the deepest technical investigations and tradecraft stays with the senior experts closest to the work
  • Capable of independently leading complex investigations. 
  • Direct, prioritize, and resource complex investigations into model distillation, unauthorized AI R&D usage, unauthorized access, coordinated account abuse, and fraud/scam networks, partnering with the senior investigators who lead the deepest technical casework and clearing blockers from their path
  • Drive the redesign of triage for a very high-volume detection pipeline: partner with investigators and engineering to build abuse signals, clustering, and agentic investigation workflows that separate sophisticated actors from noise
  • Expand the team's coverage into fraud and scams, building the detection and investigation playbooks from the ground up
  • Own the external engagement program for the area, including regular intelligence sharing with U.S. government partners and industry peers, ensuring the investigators driving the work are visible in those channels
  • Anticipate how resellers, proxies, and third-party platforms change the abuse surface, and shape coverage accordingly
  • Work with policy, enforcement, and engineering to convert findings into bans, product mitigations, and safety-by-design improvements
  • Define and report the team's metrics; brief Safeguards and company leadership on the threat landscape

Minimum qualifications

  • Have led and managed investigative, fraud, platform integrity, or threat intelligence teams, ideally ones built around senior, deeply specialized individual contributors
  • Have strong domain fluency in scaled abuse — fraud patterns, account abuse, unauthorized access, or platform exploitation economics — sufficient to set priorities, pressure-test findings, and earn the confidence of expert investigators
  • Are proficient enough in SQL and Python to review data-heavy casework, pressure-test conclusions, and provide surge capacity when the team needs it
  • Have experience overseeing investigations that track threat actors across surface, deep, and dark web environments, including reseller and access-broker communities
  • Have working familiarity with large language models and a strong grasp of how models can be distilled, extracted, or exploited at scale
  • Have built processes, detection systems, or programs from scratch and can show what changed because of them
  • Communicate crisply with executives, engineers, and external partners alike

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience at a major technology platform on trust and safety, fraud, or abuse investigations at scale
  • Background in financial crime investigation or fraud analytics
  • Experience working directly with U.S. government stakeholders on threat reporting
  • A track record of partnering with, growing, and retaining senior technical specialists, including defining clear scope between management and senior IC tracks
  • Fluency in Mandarin Chinese and/or Russian with nuanced regional and geopolitical context
  • Active Top Secret security clearance

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$375,000—$455,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels.    Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄    We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.  Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.  We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.   Introducing the People Team at Trainline 👋  At Trainline, the People Team is central to supporting the company’s ambition and growth plans.  We are looking for a People Operations Advisor to join our UK People Operations team. Reporting into our UK People Operations Team Manager, you’ll work on all things HR and be responsible for supporting employees across the business and helping to make Trainline a great place to work. You’ll provide high quality support in relation to both core HR processes and ad-hoc projects and quickly become an integral part of the team and wider business.  If you’re successful in your application, you’ll be joining an enthused and high performing team, one which prides itself on providing stellar service at every stage of the employee life cycle, from on-boarding to off-boarding and everything in between.   As a People Operations Advisor at Trainline, you will...🚅      Provide high-quality first-line support to Trainliners  and resolving HR process and policy queries professionally and within agreed SLAs.       Produce and maintain accurate people data,  ensuring high data integrity in our HRIS (HiBob) and that updates are completed promptly. Apply a data-literate, analytical mindset to validate information and produce reports that support People Ops delivery and decision-making.       Deliver change  alongside day-to-day People services by contributing to People Ops projects such as system enhancements, process redesign, and embedding AI-enabled solutions, while balancing inbox SLAs, operational deadlines, and project work through effective planning and prioritisation to ensure reliable delivery.       Work with People Business Partners to support cyclical People processes  and document and implement employee lifecycle changes, including personal and contractual updates.       Support the preparation, validation, and processing of the monthly UK payroll,  ensuring accurate and timely data inputs and alignment between HiBob and payroll workflows.       Deliver day-to-day benefits administration,  managing enrolments and changes accurately and resolving benefit-related issues efficiently.       Manage employee lifecycle administration,  including pre-boarding, contracts, background checks, Right to Work documentation, and visa sponsorship, ensuring employee data is accurate across systems and workflows.       Process People-related invoices and purchase orders accurately,  partnering with accounts payable and supporting effective financial administration.       Support and manage the improvement, implementation, and documentation of People policies,  processes, and templates, ensuring they remain up to date, user-friendly, and aligned with a tech-first, self-service culture.    Based on the sensitive nature of the role, it’s important that you bring the appropriate degree of discretion and empathy in the way you operate. To this end, you’ll be responsible for identifying escalation points and making sure that any issues are managed appropriately and are dealt with efficiently. Furthermore, being heavily involved in all our HR processes means that you’ll be ideally placed to contribute towards the development of new solutions that further enhance the quality, competence and effectiveness of our current offering.   We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍     You bring a solid foundation in People Operations and are motivated to continue learning and developing in a fast-moving, tech-enabled environment.    Working understanding of HR best practices, employment law, and core HR processes, with the ability and curiosity to stay up to date with regulatory change.    Experience supporting payroll administration, including maintaining payroll data, running checks, and a working understanding of UK tax, NI, and statutory requirements.    Comfortable working with HR systems (ideally HiBob or similar HRIS), with a genuine interest in using technology to improve People processes.    Data-literate, with the ability to produce, interpret, and validate reports, ensure data quality, and use insights to support People Partners and business needs    Exposure to process and ways-of-working improvement, such as documenting workflows, testing system enhancements, refining templates, or supporting change implementation.    Strong attention to detail, particularly when handling people data, contracts, payroll inputs, or employee records.    Clear and professional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain policies and processes confidently.    Strong organisational and time-management skills, able to manage competing priorities, balance BAU and project work, and work to agreed SLAs.    Confident using Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, particularly Excel / Sheets for data handling and reporting.    We’re looking for a team player with a ‘roll your sleeves up’ attitude. A self-starter with a helpful, people-orientated demeanour and a high degree of integrity and confidentiality, someone itching expand upon their HR and payroll experience. Super-strong organisation and interpersonal skills are essential, and you’ll also bring the ability to work at pace and with agility.  An HR qualification isn’t necessary - as long as you can demonstrate your interest in HR and show a comprehensive understanding of HR processes and policies, we’ll provide you with the necessary professional development to make you an HR superhero.  This is fantastic opportunity for someone who is passionate about HR, keen to work in a fast-moving, forward-thinking technology business, and looking to develop their career. This is a UK-based role, but we also support offices in France, Spain and Italy. Experience working with employees in these countries would be helpful, but is not essential.     More information:   Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits.   We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one!   We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.  Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do:     💭  Think Big  - We're building the future of rail     ✔️  Own It  - We focus on every customer, partner and journey     🤝   Travel Together  - We're one team     ♻️  Do Good  - We make a positive impact     We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.  Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on  LinkedIn ,  Instagram  and  Glassdoor !    Compensation: £35K – £38K    • £35K – £38K   Find  Jobs in United Kingdom  on Arbeitnow

77e4f970576232682395.description: Bouw dataplatformen die klaar zijn voor wat er morgen met data en AI gebeurt.   Bij adesso zoeken we een Data Engineer die verder kijkt dan alleen het bouwen van pipelines. Iemand die nadenkt over hoe data wordt verzameld, gemodelleerd, ontsloten en gebruikt en die graag werkt aan moderne data-oplossingen binnen Microsoft Azure en Snowflake.  Je werkt aan dataplatformen die organisaties daadwerkelijk gebruiken. Als basis voor reporting en analytics, maar steeds vaker ook voor machine learning, AI en agentic toepassingen.     Jouw rol   Als Data Engineer ontwerp en bouw je schaalbare data-oplossingen voor onze klanten. Je werkt aan het hele traject: van databron en architectuur tot een betrouwbaar platform waarop data daadwerkelijk gebruikt kan worden.  Daarbij werk je voornamelijk binnen het Azure-ecosysteem en denk je mee over keuzes rondom architectuur, datamodellering, performance en schaalbaarheid.  Je bent niet alleen degene die bouwt. Je begrijpt waarom bepaalde keuzes worden gemaakt, kunt hierover sparren met klanten en collega's en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van de oplossing.     Wat ga je doen?   ·       Ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van schaalbare data pipelines en dataplatformen;  ·       Ontwikkelen van cloud-native data-oplossingen;  ·       Integreren, transformeren en ontsluiten van data uit verschillende bronnen;  ·       Ontwerpen en implementeren van moderne Data Warehouse- en Lakehouse-architecturen;  ·       Toepassen van datamodelleringsmethodieken zoals Kimball en Data Vault;  ·       Bouwen van betrouwbare datasets voor analytics, dashboards, machine learning en AI-toepassingen;  ·       Werken met technologieën zoals Microsoft Fabric, Azure   Databricks, Azure Data Factory en Snowflake;  ·       Optimaliseren van performance, schaalbaarheid, betrouwbaarheid en datakwaliteit;  ·       Inrichten en verbeteren van CI/CD-processen en toepassen van DataOps-principes;  ·       Meedenken met klanten over data-architectuur, integraties en technische keuzes;  ·       Samenwerken met Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Data Architects en andere specialisten binnen ons Data & AI-team.       We zoeken niet iemand die ieder vinkje op een technologielijst kan zetten. We zoeken vooral een Data Engineer die een stevig technisch fundament heeft, nieuwsgierig blijft en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor wat hij of zij bouwt.  Je hebt:  ·       Minimaal 4 jaar relevante ervaring als Data Engineer of in een vergelijkbare rol;  ·       Sterke kennis van SQL en Python;  ·       Ervaring met het ontwerpen en bouwen van ETL/ELT-processen en data pipelines;  ·       Ervaring met Microsoft Azure en relevante Azure-datadiensten, zoals Databricks, Fabric, Snowflake;  ·       Ervaring met datamodellering en moderne data-architecturen, bijvoorbeeld Kimball en Data Vault;  ·       Kennis van Data Warehouse- en/of Lakehouse-concepten;  ·       Ervaring met CI/CD, DevOps en bij voorkeur Infrastructure as Code;  ·       Oog voor datakwalitei

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking a partnerships leader to own the tri-party motion for public sector and nonprofit partnerships selling through AWS. Public sector and nonprofit-focused partners are how Claude reaches government agencies, educational institutions, and mission-driven organizations at scale, and AWS is the surface most of that work runs on. You will own the intersection of those two ecosystems.

In this role, you will build the go-to-market motion that turns partner interest into joint pipeline and closed revenue, working across AWS's public sector partner organization and the AWS practices inside the partners that serve government and nonprofit customers. You will define how Claude is positioned inside AWS public sector partner programs, design the commercial mechanics that let partners transact and get rewarded through procurement vehicles and contract structures specific to this segment, and build the joint plays that partners take to their customers.

This is a build role. The partner ecosystem is early, the programs are still being designed, and you will be operating across three organizations whose incentives on any given deal don't always line up. You will help shape how frontier AI technology reaches the public sector and nonprofit community through the partner ecosystem, including in classified environments where required.

You will report directly to the Head of AWS GTM Partnerships and work closely with our Global Public Sector Leader.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the GTM strategy for our public sector and nonprofit partnerships through AWS, including co-selling motions, joint business plans, events, and segment-specific plays across federal, state and local, education, and nonprofit
  • Own forecasting, pipeline development, and revenue targets for partner-sourced and partner-influenced business
  • Design the commercial mechanics that make the partner motion work, including deal registration, marketplace program structure, procurement and contract vehicle alignment, and incentives
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships across AWS's public sector partner organization and across partner AWS practice leadership
  • Work with partners to develop repeatable, mission-specific solutions built on Claude, and help them build the delivery capability to take those solutions to public sector and nonprofit customers
  • Partner cross-functionally with Anthropic's alliances, public sector sales, partner marketing, policy, and regional cloud teams to keep the motion consistent while regions and segments execute locally
  • Create and implement scalable processes for partnership operations, including escalation management, business reviews, and reporting
  • Provide strategic market intelligence and competitive insights on the public sector and nonprofit partner ecosystem to inform product and commercial strategy
  • Identify where to concentrate investment across the partner portfolio and make the case to stop investing where returns are not there

Minimum qualifications

  • Active security clearance (TS/SCI required) with ability to discuss capabilities in classified environments
    Enterprise partnerships, alliances, or business development experience, with meaningful time spent on partner ecosystems serving public sector or nonprofit customers
  • Proven track record of building and scaling partnerships with public sector-focused systems integrators, resellers, or channel partners
  • Experience building a co-sell or channel motion from the ground up, including the commercial mechanics behind it
  • Deep understanding of how cloud and partner field organizations operate in the public sector, including procurement processes, contract vehicles, and the incentives that drive seller and partner behavior
  • Track record of carrying and hitting a partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue number, with credible forecasting behind it
  • Demonstrated ability to build credibility with and influence senior stakeholders
  • Excellence in strategic planning, business operations, and program management
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, and a willingness to concentrate effort rather than spread thin
  • Experience working with technical products and translating complex capabilities into business value
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time

Preferred qualifications

  • 12+ years of enterprise partnerships, alliances, or business development experience
  • Previous experience working with AWS or another hyperscaler's public sector partner organization
  • Working knowledge of public sector partner operating models, including practice structures, delivery economics, and how services and contract revenue drive partner decisions
  • Familiarity with government compliance and authorization frameworks (such as FedRAMP, IL levels, and StateRAMP) and how they shape partner-led deployments
  • Experience working with nonprofit, higher education, or philanthropic organizations and the funding dynamics that shape their technology decisions
  • Background in AI/ML technologies or with developer-focused platforms and their partner ecosystems
  • Experience scaling partner programs at a company moving from early traction to significant partner-driven revenue
  • Prior experience in management consulting or federal program management

About the role

Anthropic sells Claude through partners as well as directly. In the public sector, those partners matter more than anywhere else. As Channel Partner Manager, Public Sector, you will own Anthropic's reseller and distributor relationships across US federal, state and local government, and you will build the operations that let those partners transact with us quickly and cleanly.

Your time will be split roughly evenly between two kinds of work. The first is partner management. You will be the primary Anthropic contact for our public sector partners, agree on a joint plan with each of them, and work with our public sector account teams so that partner and direct motions support each other rather than collide. The second is channel operations. You will onboard new partners, instance an agreement for each of them, run deal registration, administer rebates, and keep the program's processes and records in order.

Every partner adds a fixed amount of operational work regardless of revenue, so the processes you build will determine how quickly public sector customers can buy. Much of this does not exist at Anthropic yet, and building it to a standard our partners and teams can rely on will be a large part of your first year.

You will work closely with Legal, Finance and with our public sector sales team on pipeline. You will also work with the public sector teams at the cloud providers and through cloud environments that meet federal security requirements such as FedRAMP.

Key responsibilities

  • Own Anthropic's relationships with our public sector partners, acting as their primary point of contact and building relationships with their public sector and alliance leadership
  • Agree on a joint business plan with each partner covering target segments, contract vehicles, pipeline, enablement and marketing, and run regular business reviews against it
  • Work with our federal, state and local, and education account teams to align partner and direct motions, clear conflicts early, and route each opportunity through the right partner and contract vehicle
  • Run partner onboarding end to end, from application and diligence through agreement execution, enablement and a first transaction
  • Own partner agreements with Legal, keeping contract vehicle coverage and program terms current
  • Own deal registration for the public sector channel, making sure registrations are submitted, validated and conflict cleared, and that every deal names its end customer
  • Manage partner rebates and program incentives with Finance
  • Build and run the channel's operating processes, including quoting, order handling and partner reporting, with clear service levels and documentation
  • Work with the cloud providers' public sector teams so that partner deals run cleanly through cloud marketplaces and authorized cloud environments
  • Forecast and report partner sourced pipeline and resale revenue for the public sector channel, and own that number with the reseller program and public sector sales leadership
  • Own partner escalations end to end, from billing and contracting questions to deal conflicts, and resolve them with the right internal owner
  • Represent what public sector partners and buyers need to the central reseller program team, and feed what you learn back into how the program works

Minimum qualifications

  • 7+ years in channel, partner or alliances roles in enterprise software or cloud, including at least 3 years focused on the US public sector
  • Direct experience managing reseller or distributor relationships that sell to government or education buyers
  • Working knowledge of how public sector buyers purchase technology, including contract vehicles, two-tier distribution, and the role of resellers in public procurement
  • Working fluency in channel program mechanics, including deal registration, partner onboarding, margin and rebates
  • Experience running channel or partner operations, including agreements, program administration, reporting, and the systems behind them
  • Experience building processes and working rhythms from zero, and comfort joining a new program early
  • Clear written and spoken communication with Legal, Finance and Sales teams, and the judgment to hold program rules under commercial pressure
  • Excitement about Anthropic's mission to develop AI that is safe and beneficial

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with FedRAMP and with selling software that runs in authorized cloud environments
  • Experience with federal, state and education contract vehicles
  • Experience with cloud marketplace resale for public sector buyers, including private offers
  • Experience on the reseller or distributor side of a vendor relationship, as well as the vendor side
  • Familiarity with how government agencies and education institutions are evaluating and adopting AI

You’ll take the cases that need more than a help article: understanding how a customer has built on our platform (their integrations, their authentication and identity setup, their use of the models) and then investigating, diagnosing, and resolving their most complex technical needs. You’ll partner with engineers to get to the bottom of things, and with account teams to keep the customer’s trust while you do.

Additionally, you’ll help us identify and close gaps in our team’s technical knowledge, turning what you learn from each case into documentation, tooling, and product feedback so the whole team gets sharper. This is a role for someone who wants their technical depth to matter to real businesses, and who cares as much about how we systematically support customers at scale as about the case in front of them.

Responsibilities

  • Provide high-touch support to our most strategic customers, communicating clearly and empathetically with a wide range of user personas, context-switching between guiding an executive through an incident and providing critical product knowledge to an admin in need of help within the same hour
  • Serve as an escalation point for our most complex technical issues: reproducing customer issues, utilizing logs and traces, and providing solutions alongside engineers
  • Troubleshoot SSO, SAML, and OAuth authentication flows, and the integration surface where our products meet a customer’s infrastructure
  • Partner with engineers, teammates, and other internal stakeholders to diagnose and resolve user issues, both individually and at scale

  • Respond to user support cases with a variety of complexity, from questions from individuals to complex API debugging for large businesses
  • Become an expert in all Anthropic products, and delight in the hunt when something doesn’t behave as expected
  • Uplevel our team’s technical knowledge by scoping gaps, working with cross-functional partners to deeply understand relevant nuances, and building resources that grow with our products
  • Suggest and drive improvements to increase user satisfaction through support processes, as well as own initiatives that increase efficiency and drive down contact rates
  • Operate in ambiguity, making informed decisions even in never-before-seen situations
  • Prioritize critically and comfortably adapt to an ever-evolving product landscape

  • Several years of technical product support experience at a high-growth tech company, including hands-on API debugging, ideally on a tier-two, escalated, or priority support team
  • Experience supporting enterprise or strategic accounts: exec-level communication, escalation management, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with account and engineering teams
  • Fluency with APIs and technical SaaS products; you read technical docs with ease and can reason about someone else’s architecture from a handful of clues
  • Experience troubleshooting SSO, SAML, and OAuth authentication flows
  • A demonstrated ability to thrive in fast-paced, reactive situations while hitting core support metrics (CSAT, SLA, and the like)
  • Strong user empathy and mastery of the support case lifecycle; you read between the lines, get to the heart of the need, and resolve it fast
  • Crisp but kind written communication and a deep care for detail
  • Persistence and curiosity: you’re energized by tracking down a bug, and more energized by fixing it for every similar user going forward
  • A deep sense of ownership, genuine interest in Anthropic’s products, and enthusiasm for helping build the team

While not required, we're particularly excited about candidates with one or more of these specializations:

  • Comfort with command line interfaces and basic scripting (Bash, Python, JavaScript)
  • SQL proficiency for querying logs and investigating issues
  • Understanding of LLM capabilities, practical applications, and current limitations
  • Familiarity with enterprise networking concepts and IT infrastructure
  • Familiarity with Git workflows and version control concepts
  • Experience supporting government or public sector customers, including compliance requirements and security frameworks
  • Background in team lead roles or managing contract/vendor support teams

Build the next generation of autonomous construction robotics  
 At MESH, we develop autonomous robotic systems that automate end-to-end rebar construction. Bridging digital design and physical automation, our multidisciplinary team transforms advanced robotics research into robust, production-ready industrial systems deployed globally. 
 Tasks 
  Role description  
 We are looking for a Robotics Software Engineer to develop and productize software across the full robotics stack from perception and motion planning to control and system integration. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working across subsystem boundaries. You will take ownership of the engineering work required to turn promising research and algorithms into robust and mature capabilities that can be deployed and maintained in real-world robotic systems. 
 What You Will Work On 
 You will contribute across the full robotics software stack, including: 
 
 Perception: 2D/3D sensing, point-cloud processing, object and feature detection, pose estimation, calibration. 
 Motion Planning: collision checking, trajectory generation and optimization, kinematics, robot/world modeling, and integration of planning algorithms. 
 Robot Control: integration with industrial robot controllers, HAL layers, trajectory execution, real-time or near-real-time control interfaces, state monitoring, and coordination of multi-robotic systems. 
 System Integration: connecting robotics SW, application logic, hardware, and external systems into reliable end-to-end robotic applications. 
 Robotics Infrastructure: reusable software components, interfaces, configuration, logging, diagnostics, testing, simulation, and deployment infrastructure. 
 
 Your Responsibilities 
 
 Design, implement, test, and maintain robotics software primarily in C++ and Python. 
 Develop and integrate components across the full robotics SW stack. 
 Take algorithms and prototypes and mature them into reliable software components. 
 Build automated tests, simulation-based tests, hardware-in-the-loop tests, and system-level validation where appropriate. 
 Work with industrial robots, sensors, cameras, external axes, and other automation hardware. 
 Develop clean interfaces between robotics algorithms, hardware drivers, application software, and higher-level systems. 
 Diagnose complex problems that span software, algorithms, networking, robot controllers, sensors, and hardware. 
 Improve observability through structured logging, diagnostics, error reporting, and system health monitoring. 
 Support deployment, commissioning, troubleshooting, and validation of robotic systems. 
 
 Requirements 
  What We Are Looking For  
 Required 
 
 Masters degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field. 
 Strong software engineering skills in C++, with working knowledge of Python. 
 Experience developing software for robotic or other complex hardware systems. 
 Good understanding of several areas of robotics, such as, motion and trajectory planning, robot control, vision, sensor and robot calibration. 
 Experience with robotics middleware such as ROS/ROS2 or similar 
 Comfortable working with Linux and modern software development workflows using Git, code reviews, build systems, debugging tools, and automated testing. 
 Ability to debug problems across multiple layers of a robotic system rather than treating individual components in isolation. 
 Strong understanding of software architecture, modularity, interfaces, and maintainability. 
 
 Experience in one or more of the following would be an advantage: 
 
 3D perception using point clouds, depth cameras, stereo systems. 
 Libraries such as Eigen, PCL, OpenCV, or similar. 
 Collision detection, robot/world modeling, trajectory optimization, or numerical optimization. 
 Real-time or high-performance robot communication and control. 
 Profiling, performance optimization, concurrency, and multithreaded C++. 
 Deploying and supporting robotic systems outside a controlled R&D environment. 
 CI/CD and automated testing for robotics software. 
 Experience working with industrial robotic arms such as ABB 
 
 We do not expect you to be an expert in every part of the robotics stack. We are looking for strong software engineering fundamentals, depth in one or more robotics areas, and the ability and interest to work across subsystem boundaries. 
  Eligibility  
 Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Switzerland or be eligible to obtain the required Swiss work authorization without employer-sponsored visa support. 
  Why Join MESH?  
 At MESH, you will work on robotics problems where advanced R&D meets real-world industrial deployment. Our goal is not only to develop new robotics capabilities, but to turn them into systems that solve challenging problems in real world deployments. 
 
 You will have opportunities to work across the full robotics SW stack including system integration, and the software architecture connecting them rather than being restricted to a narrow subsystem. 
 You will work directly on the engineering challenges that take robotics from promising prototypes to robust, repeatable, and deployable solutions. 
 Solve challenging real-world robotics problems. Work with industrial robots, 3D vision systems, complex environments, and applications where conventional automation approaches reach their limits. 
 See your work operate on real hardware. Develop software that moves beyond simulation and demos and becomes part of robotic systems deployed in real production environments. 
 Have impact across the system. As part of a small, multidisciplinary engineering team, you will work closely across robotics, software, and hardware, with the opportunity to influence both technical decisions and how our robotics platform evolves.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the team

Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a world-class research group focused on making fundamental biological discoveries. The team combines cutting-edge AI with hands-on biological research, positioning Anthropic at the forefront of AI-accelerated scientific discovery.

About the role

We're seeking an exceptional Research Scientist to join the team. As a founding member of Life Sciences, you'll work in a high-impact group that operates at the intersection of computational and experimental biology. You'll help establish Anthropic as a leader in biology research while developing product intuition through direct engagement with the challenges and opportunities of laboratory science.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, execute, and iterate on the experimental programs at the core of the team's research: molecular biology, biochemistry, protein and nucleic acid characterization, high-throughput functional screens, and the assay development that makes new questions answerable
  • Partner directly with computational biologists to design experiments that produce high-quality, analysis-ready data, and feed results back fast enough to immediately inform the next round of analysis
  • Generate and prioritize hypotheses by combining your experimental judgment with the literature, curated biological knowledge bases, and the team's computational predictions
  • Use Claude and our internal agent frameworks heavily in your own work — for experimental planning, protocol development, and data interpretation — and feed what you learn back to the model-improvement and product teams as evaluations, datasets, and concrete failure cases

Minimum qualifications

  • Have a Ph.D. in a biological science (molecular biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, computational biology) or a related field
  • Have a track record of bridging biological domain knowledge with computational approaches to solve real scientific problems
  • Have basic proficiency in Python and are familiar with ML development practices

Preferred qualifications

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and developing solutions in rapidly evolving research environments
  • Can work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with cross-functional teams
  • Are results-oriented, with a bias towards flexibility and impact
  • Thrive in a fast-paced research environment where you balance rigorous scientific standards with rapid iteration
  • Published research or practical experience in scientific AI applications
  • Familiarity with modern machine learning techniques and model training methodologies
  • Familiarity with biological databases (UniProt, GenBank, PDB) and computational biology tools

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how AI transforms biological research. You'll work with some of the world's best AI researchers while tackling problems that matter deeply for human health and scientific understanding. If you're excited about using your expertise to make fundamental biological discoveries and guide the development of transformative AI systems, we want to hear from you.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$300,000—$320,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows. 

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design. 

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

As a key member of our Customer Success organization, the Professional Services Engineer serves as a technical authority in the Tines platform, specializing in integrating and optimizing workflow automation solutions across customer enterprises.

In this role, you will guide customers through scoping out automation Stories to suit their individual requirements and design, build, & deploy these solutions in the customer tenant. These Stories will be instrumental in kick-starting the customer’s automation journey and ensuring that they and their team feel the benefits of smart, secure workflows.

You will partner with our Engagement Management and Project Management Teams to align on project goals and timelines, guaranteeing that client implementations are successful and meet predefined success criteria.

Professional Services Engineers at Tines engage with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, Sales, and Labs. This collaboration ensures that our service offerings and product enhancements align well with evolving customer requirements. The ideal candidate for this role will be deeply committed to enhancing customer productivity through advanced automation solutions, leveraging their technical expertise to transform client operations without the necessity for manual coding.

This role reports to the Senior Manager, Professional Services Engineering who is based in Boston, Massachusetts.

What you will be doing:

  • Shape the future of our Professional Services organization and contribute to the development of processes and procedures.
  • Tackle challenging Story and workflow builds to power our customers’ most important workflows.
  • Scope automation Stories based on customer requirements, identifying any blockers and research areas needed.
  • Analyze customer tools, processes, and pain points to guide them in establishing an automation roadmap.
  • Identify and highlight what is, and what isn’t, suitable for an automation workflow.
  • Work with the Project Manager and Engagement Manager to verify and validate services, project plans, and timelines.
  • Demonstrate Stories and workflows to illustrate concepts and ideas to the customer, including wire-framing out Stories and workflows live on calls with customers.
  • Design and develop Automation Stories and workflows in the customer Tines tenant, connecting tools together using their APIs.
  • Partner closely with customers to ensure that the Stories and workflows meet their requirements and provide guidance on test plans.
  • Review and suggest optimizations for customer stories and workflows.
  • Deliver documented, production-ready stories and workflows to customers and ensure the customer is set up for success in maintaining those long-term.
  • Act as a resident automation engineer for customers, working as a member of the customer team to help them plan their automation roadmap and achieve their automation goals.
  • Advocate for the Professional Services Team within Tines, working with Sales teams to ensure they can speak to our capabilities and achievements.

What you bring with you:

  • 5+ years of experience in delivering Professional Services and implementing SOAR platforms or similar automation solutions.
  • Strong customer-facing skills and experience.
  • A passion for becoming an expert in a Tines.
  • Proficient in assessing and understanding customer workflows to tailor solutions that meet their specific needs.
  • Experience interpreting and applying API documentation.
  • Experience with a range of API authentication methods including OAuth2 and JWT.
  • Experience using and troubleshooting APIs to connect to a variety of security and/or IT tools.
  • Passionate about supporting our customers and helping them automate their repetitive and manual workflows.

 

At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

Tines provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, colour, ethnic or social origin, genetic features, language, religion or belief, political or any other opinion, membership of a national minority, property, birth, disability, age or sexual orientation.

7da07965f63b14262c0f.description: About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and open up new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a lot of work ahead. That gives you an unusual opportunity to help put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Startup SaaS Platforms team works with European startups in one of Stripe’s must-win segments. SaaS platforms are companies that use Stripe to embed payments and make financial services a core part of their products, such as Shopify, Mindbody, and Lightspeed. For these companies, their partnership with Stripe is vital to the success of their businesses. SaaS platforms are a global priority for Stripe, and our team finds and wins Stripe’s future strategic accounts in Europe. We partner with high-potential companies early and help them use Stripe’s solutions to better support their users, scale globally, and create new revenue streams by monetising payments and financial services. What you’ll do We’re hiring an Account Executive to win new business with pre-revenue and early-stage SaaS platform startups across the United Kingdom and Ireland. This is a new-logo role. Your job is to find the most promising founders building platforms today, win their business for Stripe before they choose another provider, and get them live with the right integration from day one. You’ll work alongside our SaaS Platform Account Executives as the team’s dedicated hunter for the earliest stage of the market. You’ll own the pre-revenue and early-revenue segment end to end, from generating pipeline and handling inbound demand to closing deals and getting each new platform activated. Early-stage platforms make their payments decisions early and rarely revisit them. They also often need several products from the start, including embedded payments, connected-account onboarding, payouts, and monetisation. Winning them early and selling the right solution gives Stripe a lasting position with the platforms that will scale fastest. This is a high-velocity sales role with short cycles, a high volume of opportunities, and plenty of competitive deals. Responsibilities Build and run your own pipeline. Prospect high-potential pre-revenue and early-stage SaaS platforms across the United Kingdom and Ireland, and turn inbound interest from early-stage platforms into qualified opportunities. Win new logos. Run fast, consultative sales cycles from discovery to close and win competitive evaluations against other payments providers. Sell the right solution from the start. Understand each founder’s business model and position the right Stripe Connect integration and payments monetisation strategy so that new platforms are set up to scale. Close and activate. Negotiate and close deals, then work with Solutions Architects, Product, Risk, and Operations to get new platforms live quickly. You’ll be measured on new business won and activated. Source new business through the ecosystem. Build relationships with founders, venture capital firms, accelerators, and startup communities across the United Kingdom and Ireland to create pipeline and grow Stripe’s presence among early-stage founders. Work with the SaaS Platform Account Executive team. Share market intelligence on emerging platforms and pass on accounts that have moved beyond the early stage so that each seller can focus on the opportunities where they can have the greatest impact. Bring what you learn from the market back to Product and go-to-market teams to sharpen how Stripe wins early-stage platforms. Who you are You’re a self-starting hunter who enjoys finding and winning new business. You like working with founders, you’re comfortable leading technical conversations, and you can run many deals at once without compromising quality. You know how to qualify quickly, create urgency, and close. You’re competitive, resilient, and keen to build your skills in a fast-changing environment. We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 2+ years of experience in a new-business sales role, such as a closing Account Executive role or a Sales or Business Development Representative role, with a track record of progression and pipeline generation A proven record of meeting or exceeding new-business targets Strong prospecting skills, with experience building your own pipeline through outbound and inbound channels Experience running high-velocity sales cycles from the first conversation through to close The ability to understand technical products and explain their value clearly to technical and non-technical buyers Comfort with rejection, competitive deals, and ambiguous, fast-moving environments A bias towards team success, collaboration, and knowledge sharing Proficiency in written and spoken English Preferred qualifications Experience selling to early-stage or venture-backed startups, ideally in the United Kingdom and Ireland An established network in the United Kingdom and Ireland startup ecosystem, including founders, venture capital firms, and accelerators Experience selling at a high-growth technology company Comfort with API-first products and technical sales conversations Experience in payments, fintech, or SaaS platform sales

We are looking for research engineers to build the safety and oversight mechanisms that govern how our models handle biological knowledge. As a bio safety researcher, you will spend your time: designing and running capability evaluations against frontier models, generating and curating training data for our safety classifiers, training and iterating on those classifiers alongside our ML engineers, and measuring how they hold up against adversarial pressure in production traffic.

This work sits at the intersection of applied ML and biosecurity. You will help define what responsible AI safety looks like in the biological domain, translating threat models into evals, datasets, and deployed systems. The core technical tension you will own is precision: safeguards need to be robust against sophisticated actors while staying out of the way of the far larger population of legitimate researchers using Claude to accelerate life sciences work. Getting that tradeoff right is an empirical problem, and you will be the person measuring it.

You do not need to be an ML researcher today. We are looking for strong scientific programmers with real depth in modern biology who want to bring that depth to bear on model evaluation and classifier development.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and run capability evaluations to assess what new models can do in the biological domain, and turn results into concrete deployment recommendations
  • Develop training and evaluation datasets for our safety classifiers, working with internal and external threat modeling experts to ground them in realistic risk
  • Train, tune, and iterate on safety classifiers with ML engineers, optimizing jointly for adversarial robustness and low false-positive rates
  • Build the tooling and pipelines that make evaluation and classifier development fast and repeatable
  • Analyze classifier and eval performance against production traffic, identify gaps, and prioritize improvements
  • Design and run red-teaming and stress-testing of safeguards as threats, models, and product surfaces evolve
  • Partner with Research, Product, and Policy teams to embed biological safety throughout the model development lifecycle
  • Contribute to external communications including model cards, blog posts, and policy documents
  • Track developments in biology, ML, and biosecurity for their potential to create new risks or enable new mitigations

Minimum qualifications

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and extensive background in scientific programming and data analysis skills
  • Excellent grasp of ML fundamentals and an ability to rapidly adopt ML development practices
  • Excellent knowledge of modern biology across both measurement and engineering: high-throughput assays and functional characterization, as well as gene synthesis, genome editing, strain construction, and protein engineering
  • Ability to build and maintain your own tooling rather than relying on others to implement your ideas
  • Experience designing quantitative experiments or evaluations and drawing defensible conclusions from noisy results
  • Strong analytical and writing skills, and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Familiarity with dual-use research concerns and biosecurity frameworks, such as select agent regulations, the Biological Weapons Convention, or Australia Group guidelines
  • Comfort with ambiguity and with shifting priorities as AI capabilities change
  • Can work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with cross-functional teams
  • Are results-oriented, with a bias towards flexibility and impact
  • Thrive in a fast-paced research environment where you balance rigorous scientific standards with rapid iteration

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience working with large language models, including prompting, fine-tuning, or evaluation
  • Experience training or deploying classifiers or other ML systems in production
  • Experience developing ML methods for biological systems or biological data
  • Familiarity with adversarial robustness, red-teaming, or safety evaluation of ML systems
  • Have at least 8 years of hands-on experience in life sciences, with deep expertise in areas such as molecular biology, drug discovery, or computational biology
  • Experience leading complex technical projects across multiple stakeholder groups

7f500636f804de99a475.description: AI & Data Graduate Programme FY28 Application Deadline: 25 October 2026 Department: Strategy & Consulting Ireland Employment Type: Permanent - Full Time Location: Dublin Compensation: €40,000 / year Description Technology is changing the world faster than ever before – and at the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference, come and be a part of our team. Every day around the world, we work with exceptional people, the latest and greatest tech and leading companies across industries. You'll learn, grow and advance in a diverse culture of shared success, where we’ll empower you to bring your skills, your curiosity and your best true self to your work. Join us and do extraordinary things. The question every major organisation is working on right now is the same: how do we get real value from AI, serve our customers better and change how our business operates? That is the work our AI and Data practice does. As a graduate, you will work directly with clients on that question. You will join project teams taking AI from strategy through to delivery, help organisations understand what their data can do, and build the confidence to advise senior stakeholders on decisions that matter. The technical depth you bring will be put to work on real problems from the start. This role is for people who want to understand a business, shape a solution and help make it happen. Here is a taster of the diverse work our AI & Data analysts do: Radically reimagine a client process with AI and be at the heart of the delivery Scale AI solutions for the world's largest companies as an AI engineer Define the most valuable commercial use cases for a client as an AI strategist Drive enterprise AI adoption, from frontier AI tools to AI-native software delivery Surface insights that executives can act on as a data scientist What We're Looking For We are looking for graduates who combine strong analytical and technical ability with the confidence to work directly with clients. The role requires both: people who can get into the detail of the latest frontier AI model, and people who can step back and explain what it means to a business audience. We are looking for graduates who are familiar with any number of the following: Knowledge of how data and AI can be used to solve business problems Experience with generative AI and agentic AI technologies Cloud data platform experience/knowledge (AWS, MS Azure, Google Cloud Platform) Data science knowledge with any of Python, SAS, R, Scala, PySpark or other relevant coding language Knowledge of machine learning modelling techniques Knowledge of data warehouse tools and database technologies e.g., SQL, ETL, No-SQL and other big data technologies Experience in or knowledge of data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Qlik, Looker or Power BI Familiarity across all technical areas is not expected. As well as technical ability, you should be able to demonstrate: Structured thinking & the ability to break a complex problem into clear components Genuine curiosity about how organisations operate & where technology can help Strong verbal/written communication & presentation skills Ability to adapt and learn in a continuously changing environment Experience in team or leadership roles in extra-curricular activities Creativity, initiative, and a growth mindset All candidates will have a minimum 2:1 degree, obtained or predicted. What's In It For You? Training & Development We’ll invest in your development from your first day and ensure you have all the training you need to hit the ground running. We provide a structured and detailed induction programme with our supportive graduate community. You can also look forward to mentorship from some of our most successful leaders. You will have dedicated training, project and research assignments in areas like Data Analysis, Gen AI and Analytics strategy. This training will help you build the all-round skills needed for success, but your project experience is where your learning will really come to life. The variety of live client work you take on will help you develop skills that stay with you throughout your career, while virtual classrooms and on-demand learning will keep you close to the latest technologies, industry trends and new ways of working. Rewards & Benefits At Accenture, in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package. You can read up about some of these benefits here . Where You'll Work Accenture is a people first business which thrives on collaboration, knowledge sharing and building strong connections. As a dynamic and constantly evolving business, we love the flexibility of a hybrid working model. However, due to the nature of our work, you may be delivering projects on client sites anywhere in the Ireland and sometimes outside of Ireland. You will be expected to work on client site or in your assigned office for a minimum of 1-2 days a week (but up to 5 depending on business and client requirements). There is an expectation for all graduates to be based within a commutable distance of your assigned office which will be Dublin . Does this appeal to you? If so, we want to hear from you! All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, colour, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as applicable by law. Job candidates will not be obligated to disclose sealed or expunged records of conviction or arrest as part of the hiring process. Please read Accenture’s Recruiting and Hiring Statement for more information on how we process your data during the Recruiting and Hiring process.

We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As one of our first Data Scientists dedicated to policy work, you will play a key role in ensuring Anthropic's work is understood by policymakers around the world. You'll sit at the intersection of data science and public affairs, transforming internal product usage and survey data into clear, accurate, and consistent evidence the Policy team can use to inform its positions, demonstrate Anthropic’s relevance to policymakers, and measure the impact of its work. Your analyses will directly inform how legislators, regulators, and the public understand Anthropic's footprint and contribution. This is a highly cross-functional role that is foundational to Anthropic's mission of bringing powerful AI to the world in a way that benefits humanity. Key responsibilities Partner with product and business teams across the company to produce supporting analyses and data collateral for specific policy position papers and partnership conversations Determine which metrics faithfully represent our company to legislators, regulators, and the public Own the dashboards and pipelines that keep externally-shared numbers consistent, so the Policy team can move quickly without creating discrepancies Use AI tools to aggregate news, policy developments, and other public data sources to track trends and provide a clear picture of the evolving regulatory landscape Develop measurement frameworks for policy communications, paid media, and public-affairs campaigns Design and implement policy analyses to support internal position development or mission of building safe and beneficial AI Deadline to apply: None. Annual Salary: $285,000 - $380,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
